test_title: PYST 65: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

My cousin thinks that / English is difficult / than other subjects.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence contains an incorrect comparison.
 
• The use of "than" in this context is inappropriate, as it must be preceded by a comparative adjective.
 
• The correct form should be "English is more difficult than other subjects" to convey proper comparison.

Therefore, the error is located in **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My cousin thinks that English is more difficult than other subjects."*
